You are glowing. Right now ✨

In 2009, scientists in Japan filmed five volunteers with a camera that can catch single particles of light. The human body gives off visible light, about 1,000 times too weak for your eyes to see. They link it to metabolism. It was brightest around 4 pm, dimmest around 10 am, and brightest of all on the face.

So you are a firefly. Just a very, very dim one.

Sources: Kobayashi et al., PLoS ONE (2009); National Geographic; NBC News.
